description: This Java source file defines a Spring Batch Tasklet 'RecalculateInterestForLoanTasklet' responsible for recalculating interest on loans. It manages batch processing of loans, handles threading, and interacts with various services for fetching loan data and triggering interest recalculations.

classes.name: RecalculateInterestForLoanTasklet
classes.description: A Spring Batch Tasklet that handles the recalculation of interest on loans. It supports batch processing with threading, retrieves loans based on job parameters or from the database, and processes them concurrently.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point for the tasklet; determines whether to process loans based on job parameters or fetch all loans needing recalculation, and initiates the process.

methods.name: recalculateInterest
methods.description: Performs batch processing of loans for interest recalculation using multi-threading, fetching loan IDs in pages and processing them concurrently.

methods.name: recalculateInterest (overloaded)
methods.description: Processes a list of loan IDs concurrently using a thread pool; submits callable tasks for each subset of loan IDs.

methods.name: checkCompletion
methods.description: Waits for all submitted asynchronous tasks to complete and logs errors if any of the threads did not execute successfully.
